summary: Bind URI execution to URN resources and explicit outcomes

delivery.outcome: Publish a typed URI/URN exchange profile with correlation, immutable contract/data bindings and truthful execution outcomes; verify its negative conformance cases.
nonGoals: Deploy a model or grant repository admission
Claim that schema conformance proves authorized execution

architecture.decision: Extend the optional semantic profile with an inert draft-2020-12 exchange envelope. Reuse registered UUID URNs for identity and existing repository admission contracts for authorization. Runtime adapters remain product-owned.
architecture.rollback: Revert this optional profile extension through protected delivery; existing legacy and semantic plan envelopes remain valid.

validation.evidence: Positive read/write/result envelopes and negative binding, ambiguity, outcome and authority-shape cases are validated.
Native scope, lease fencing, adoption and conformance CI pass.
Independent protected exact-head publication is observed, without claiming runtime adoption.
